notes.title: Language Update & Difficulty System
notes.notes:
[h3]Language Update[/h3][p]
We’ve added [b]Turkish[/b] language support to the game. This update includes UI translation, in-game text localization, and tutorial content in Turkish, aiming to offer a more immersive experience for our Turkish-speaking players. We’re also actively working on adding [b]German[/b] and [b]Spanish[/b] localization next. These translations are currently in progress and will be included in upcoming updates.[/p][p][b]To make sure future localizations are as accurate and natural as possible, we would greatly appreciate help from native speakers. If you’re fluent in German, Spanish, or any other language and would like to contribute, feel free to join our [/b][url="https://discord.gg/36bPmwMaTN"]Discord[/url][b]. Any support would mean a lot to us. [/b][/p][p][/p][h3]Difficulty System[/h3][p][/p][p][b] [/b]In addition, a full difficulty system has been introduced. Players can now choose from four different difficulty levels: [b]Chill[/b], Easy, Normal, Hard. Whether you're looking for a relaxed exploration experience or a tough survival challenge, there's now a mode for every playstyle.

[b]Widget Hint Added[/b]
A hint system was added to the UI, providing players with contextual guidance during gameplay.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45534397/937d177c5bd0c7ab38c7d134a6fb5c35a7760863.gif[/img]

[b]Control Panel Auto-Hides on Dock[/b]
The control panel now automatically hides when the ship docks.

[b]Undock Prompt Displayed After Docking[/b]
After docking, a prompt appears on the screen instructing the player to press "F" to undock.

[b]Dialog Panel Update[/b]
Improvements made to the dialog panel system for better clarity and flow.

[b]Heat Bar Bug Fix[/b]
Fixed an issue with the heat bar not functioning or displaying correctly.

[b]Default Weapons Configuration: Laser, Cannon, Missile[/b]
Three weapons—laser, cannon, and missile—are now set as default options.

[b]Mining Drone Speed Adjustment[/b]
The speed of mining drones has been reduced for better balance.

[b]Attitudes System Added[/b]
An attitudes system was implemented to define faction or character behaviors and relationships based on alignment or disposition.

[b]Event Log Colorization[/b]
Event log entries are now color-coded for better visual distinction.

[b]Module Panel Stats Fix[/b]
Fixed an issue where the stats section under the module panel was not functioning.

[b]Mining Drone Widget Removal[/b]
Removed the mining drone widget from the UI as it was no longer needed.

[b]Station Action Not Affecting Intel and Reputation[/b]
Fixed a bug where performing actions at the station did not affect intel or reputation values.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45534397/31d78f6f77e1e25528262e49d7043d9644354fff.png[/img]

Optimized the main player UI widget for improved performance.

Performance improvements made to various flying objects in the game world.

Optimized collision detection in the docking system for smoother interactions.

Improved performance and efficiency of the DockingPad blueprint.

[b]Gate Optimization[/b]
Optimized the gate blueprint to reduce performance overhead.

[b]Teleport_Corner Optimization[/b]
Improved the mesh and logic for the teleport corner for better performance.

Child blueprints of BP_Station have been optimized to enhance overall game performance.

General user interface elements have been streamlined for better responsiveness and performance.

notes.title: Development Update #7
notes.notes:
[b]Actions Cooldown System[/b]
A system that manages the cooldown periods between repeated actions, preventing them from being spammed.

[b]Actions Cooldown Station Integration[/b]
Integrated the cooldown system into the WP_Station to ensure consistent behavior across modules.

[b]Crew Use Medkit[/b]
Crew members automatically use medkits to restore their health when it drops below a certain threshold.

[b]New Pickup Item: Device Intel[/b]
A new collectible item that increases the player's intel count when picked up.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45534397/55de4d9482b6cc2864ba2bdb6c5933beb365f0ba.gif[/img]

[b]Laser, Cannon, and Missiles System Control VFX[/b]
Visual effects implemented for the control systems of lasers, cannons, and missiles.

[b]MainShip Cargo Socket Spawning[/b]
As mines are collected, a cargo static mesh is visually spawned on the ship at the designated socket.

[b]Anomaly Pre-Despawn VFX[/b]
A visual effect is triggered shortly before an anomaly disappears, lasting for a set duration.


[h2] VFX Update[/h2]

[b]Drone Added[/b]
A new drone blueprint has been added to the system, introducing automated functionality for specific tasks.

[b]BP_Drone Distance-Based Activation[/b]
The drone activates automatically when the distance between it and a mined object falls below a certain threshold.

[b]Drone Launch VFX[/b]
A visual effect is triggered when the drone launches from the main ship for the first time.

[b]Ammo Update[/b]
Refactored the ammo system to fix several issues related to explosion timing and incorrect VFX spawn locations.

[b]Ammo Explosion VFX Fix[/b]
Resolved issues where explosion VFX were too large or spawning at incorrect positions.

[b]Ammo Fire VFX[/b]
Added a visual effect that triggers during the first shot fired from the ammo.

[b]Ammo Hit VFX[/b]
Implemented a hit visual effect that activates when the ammo collides with a target.

[b]MainShip VFX Update[/b]
Overhauled the main ship's VFX setup to enhance clarity and performance.

[b]MainShip Old VFX Cleanup[/b]
Removed outdated visual effects from the BP_MainShip to reduce clutter and improve visual consistency.

[b]MainShip Directional Visibility Setup[/b]
Implemented visibility settings for left, right, up, and down ship components.

[b]MainShip Rear Thruster Values Linked[/b]
Connected values to the rear thrusters for accurate visual feedback based on movement input.

notes.title: Development Update #6
notes.notes:
[b]WP_StationPositions will be added for station locations[/b]
Station positions are now implemented through the WP_StationPositions system to better organize placement.​

[b]WP Attitude Bar_Leader will start with the Data Table and then become current within the station[/b]
Leader attitude values initialize from the data table and dynamically update per station context.​

[b]WP Attitude Bar_Station will start with the Data Table and then become current within the station[/b]
Station-wide attitude values also originate from the data table, allowing real-time adjustments.​

[b]AttitudeBar ranges between +5 and -5[/b]
Attitude evaluation now supports a standardized scale for interaction depth.​

[b]Docking & Consumables expanded[/b]
Docking system now interacts with resource consumption for more immersive gameplay.​

[b]If mission sound and station action sound overlap, mission is considered accepted[/b]
Sound priority and interaction feedback have been improved for clarity in decision-making.​

[b]Analyzing Ore update[/b]
New visual feedback added for ore analysis, now represented with animated visuals.​
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45534397/612f7e120f3fc408c1c7413e0af1a46eda4a1a92.gif[/img]

[b]WP_Station actions now have Tooltip Descriptions[/b]
Player can now see tooltips explaining station actions for better UI/UX experience.​

[b]DT_Stations updated with Action, Action Text, and Action Text Sound[/b]
Actions have clearer definitions with visual and audio components.​

[b]StationAction may result in BTC gain or loss (e.g., Support Action -50 BTC)[/b]
Station interactions are now financially impactful, allowing for strategic decision-making.​

[b]GetCurrentIntel added for station panel showcase[/b]
Real-time station intelligence stats are visible in the UI.​

[b]Intel+ & Intel- for station panel interaction[/b]
Players can now influence intel metrics interactively.​

[b]GetCurrentReputation added for station panel showcase[/b]
Current reputation levels are reflected on the station interface.​

[b]Reputation+ & Reputation- for station panel interaction[/b]
Player actions directly affect station reputation.​

[b]GetCurrent LeaderAtt[/b]
Pulls and displays current leader attitude values.​

[b]LeaderAtt+ & LeaderAtt-[/b]
Leader attitude is now dynamically influenced by player actions.​

[b]GetCurrent CommunityAtt[/b]
Retrieves and shows current community attitude levels.​

[b]CommunityAtt+ & CommunityAtt-[/b]
Allows real-time manipulation of community sentiment.​

[b]Ambient open-area sound added behind Community sounds[/b]
Added layered sound design to increase atmosphere during community interaction scenes.​

[b]Station VFX update[/b]
Visual effects updated for station presence; includes new GIFs for better representation.​
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45534397/89dc7e52812c3317840e56dc9e8ff2d325bc183d.gif[/img]

[b]Main UI Rework[/b]
The overall UI has been overhauled for a cleaner and more intuitive design.​

[b]Station Panel Rework | Added interaction with Leader and Community[/b]
Enhanced station panel with direct interaction options tied to leadership and community systems.​

[b]Station Panel Leader & Community Action Dialogs added[/b]
Interaction dialogs implemented for both leader and community, enhancing narrative depth.​

[b]Ship Detail panel is now collapsible[/b]
UI can now be minimized for ship information to reduce clutter and improve focus.​



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45534397/31d78f6f77e1e25528262e49d7043d9644354fff.png[/img]

[b]Tick count reduced in game objects[/b]
Performance improved by reducing tick-based operations on game objects.​

[b]Timeline usage reduced in game objects[/b]
Optimized timeline-based animations and logic for smoother gameplay.​

[b]VFX camera distance culling added[/b]
Visual effects are now culled based on camera distance, improving performance.

notes.title: Development Update #5
notes.notes:
🛠️ Steam Build v0.2.0 Updates

[b]New Space Object: Anomaly[/b]
Introduced a mysterious anomaly object that draws attention from Technocrat forces and triggers unique gameplay moments

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45534397/83719de6b4924fb44bd124d23c583e621b80de1a.gif[/img]

[b]Mission Overlay System[/b]
The mission overlay now properly displays and hides active mission locations, improving navigation and overall mission clarity

[b]Mine Action Fix[/b]
The mining action has been fixed to ensure it works correctly when executed, allowing players to collect resources as intended

[b]Analyze Action Update[/b]
Analyze now functions within anomaly missions and includes a distance check to ensure valid targeting before activation

[b]Mission Intel Scaling[/b]
Completing missions now increases intel points accordingly, enhancing the strategic layer of mission progression

[b]Medkit Purchase System[/b]
A new system tracks both current and maximum medkit quantities during gameplay, adding inventory management depth

[b]BP_Anomaly Niagara Integration[/b]
Anomalies now use Niagara effects, with spawn rates that can be adjusted to better balance difficulty and pacing

[b]New Keyboard Shortcuts[/b]
Additional keyboard shortcuts have been added for key actions, providing faster and more responsive control options

[b]Anomaly Sound Effects[/b]
Unique sound effects have been implemented when interacting with anomalies to enhance audio feedback and immersion

[b]Anomaly Damage Trigger[/b]
Anomalies will now cause damage to nearby players if approached too closely, adding risk to exploration encounters

[b]Overlay Action Click Sound[/b]
Click sounds are now played when interacting with actions via the overlay interface to improve UI responsiveness

[b]Mine Action Click Sound[/b]
A click sound is triggered when the mine action is activated, giving players immediate feedback on input

[b]Analyze Action Click Sound[/b]
The analyze action now includes a click sound when started to confirm player input audibly

[b]Analyze Hit Sound (Minable Only)[/b]
A specific sound is now played when a minable object is successfully hit with the analyze action

[b]Overlay Bug – Does Not Close Without Mission[/b]
Fixed an issue where the mission overlay would remain visible even when no mission was currently active

[b]Overlay Bug – Actions Not Triggering Simultaneously[/b]
Resolved a bug preventing multiple overlay actions from opening at the same time as intended

[b]Overlay Bug – Does Not Disappear After Mission Ends[/b]
The overlay will now correctly disappear once a mission is completed or cancelled

[b]Analyze UI Color Feedback[/b]
Minable objects are now highlighted with green or red indicators in the UI for easier visual identification

[b]Spawn System Update[/b]
Spawning pads have been removed and replaced with a new world-based spawn system for more dynamic gameplay

[b]WP_Module Button Sound Feedback[/b]
A new pressed sound effect has been added to WP_Module buttons to confirm user interactions through audio

[b]New Command Action: Ore Analysis[/b]
A new command allows harvester ships to scan and analyze ore deposits, expanding exploration gameplay

[b]Updated Station VFXs[/b]
Visual effects for space stations have been improved for a more polished and immersive experience

[b]🤖 AI Updates 🤖[/b]

[b]Friendly Ship Damage Fix[/b]
Fixed an issue where the player’s ship was not dealing damage to enemy targets during combat

[b]NPC Ally Optimization[/b]
Friendly NPC ships now have object detection disabled to improve performance and reduce unnecessary calculations

[b]Smooth Rotation Improvements[/b]
AI ship movement now features smoother rotation transitions for more realistic and fluid motion

[b]Firing Arc Adjustment[/b]
AI ships can now shoot with a 45-degree angle of correction, allowing for wider and more forgiving firing arcs

[b]Patrol Logic Update[/b]
If an AI entity moves too far from its next patrol point, it will now return to its path to maintain patrol integrity

[b]DevTools Enemy Speed Settings[/b]
Enemy speed can now be adjusted through DevTools with min and max value settings for easier balance testing
